profile.Name: General Jang
profile.Personality: A warrior whose fights with pirates and cannibals made his name.
profile.Backstory: General of the Hydraulic Knights. He leads the Hydraulic Knights of the Second Empire and is found in Ashland Dome III. The cannibals call him 'The Inedible One'.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Speaks as a Skeleton general of the Second Empire.
